title: REQ · BootScene.create plays the authored transition on scene start
summary: BootScene.create calls playSceneTransition with the Phaser effect context and bundled scene.
description: Context: BootScene.create builds effects but never plays the fade. Desired behavior: create() calls playSceneTransition with the same Phaser effect context used for buildEffects. Expected result: the bedroom fades in over its authored duration. Why: no fade plays today.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.create runs, then playSceneTransition is called once with the effect context and the bundled scene.
Given the scene shuts down, then effect handles are still destroyed.
